objects.name: Detection technique coverage: ivanti-sentry-authentication-bypass
objects.description: The following analytic identifies unauthenticated access attempts to the System Manager Portal in Ivanti Sentry, exploiting CVE-2023-38035. It detects this activity by monitoring HTTP requests to specific endpoints ("/mics/services/configservice/*", "/mics/services/*", "/mics/services/MICSLogService*") with a status code of 200.
